name: Plav in a day
description_md:
Plav in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in ME. The route covers 10.7 km of walking between stops and takes about 5.3 hours for the full day, visit time at each stop included.

The day is anchored in Plav. Walkers visit 4 sightseeing stops along the path.
